experiment: Owner decision 2026-10-31: land M7R (descriptor blocks) for vendorID 0x1002 and M2R (device-local host writes) only where the first DEVICE_LOCAL|HOST_VISIBLE|HOST_COHERENT type's heap is at least 4 GiB. On windows-amd-host that type sits in a 256 MiB heap, so the landed profile must select descriptor blocks only and reproduce the M7R result. Untimed precondition, already observed before freezing (diagnostics/landed-call-counts.jsonl): landed builds on both bases issue 0 descriptor-pool create/destroy per iteration and place storage in memory type 3, call for call like the frozen M7R DLL.

providers.dawn: Dawn d04f88359 Release, MSVC, monolithic SHARED, Vulkan + Null only, DAWN_FORCE_SYSTEM_COMPONENT_LOAD=ON

sampling.orders: all 24 permutations of 4 providers, cycled twice

metric: complete = compileNs + pipelineNs + resourcesNs + sum of every iteration's operation interval + teardownNs (CPU oracle excluded). Paired ratios landed/m7r per balanced pair; bootstrap 95% CI, 10000 resamples, seed 20261029. Host clock: QueryPerformanceCounter.

acceptance.primary: landed/m7r complete and warm.operation CI95 within [0.98, 1.02] on every workload
acceptance.phases: landed/m7r warm.submit, warm.upload and warm.completion CI95 within [0.97, 1.03] on every workload
acceptance.verdict: pass only if the window is valid and primary and phases hold

validity.perWindowGate: Each workload runs in its own window under the shared GPU lock directory (mkdir/rmdir, held only for the window). Before any harness starts, a 15 s pre-window sample under the lock must show all GPU engine time, including System (PID 4), <= 2% and foreign CPU <= 5%. During the window: foreign GPU <= 2% of wall time, where foreign = PDH 'GPU Engine(*)\Utilization Percentage' summed per engine (max engine per 1 s sample, averaged) for processes whose image is neither harness-*.exe nor System (PID 4). System GPU time is WDDM video-memory paging/zeroing done for every process; it is 0.0% idle and about 7.5% on the Copy engine while harness processes run (diag/tool-check-3), so it is recorded as systemGpuPct and excluded from foreign during the window. Foreign CPU <= 5% of window CPU capacity (wall x 16 logical CPUs): GetSystemTimes busy minus the window tree (window script, cohort process, every harness child by GetProcessTimes). Zero failed processes and zero oracle misses. A/A: dawn-aa/dawn warm.operation median within [0.95,1.05] with CI95 containing 1, on every workload.
validity.windowsBackground: Background processes are left running and are measured, not stopped: two idle codex.exe daemons, a node process and a desktop app belong to other owners. Windows Search indexing and Defender scanning are counted as foreign CPU; a 60 s idle probe after they settled measured foreign CPU 0.22% and GPU 0.0% (diag/idle-probe-2).
validity.invalidWindows: An invalid window is rerun fresh under the unchanged contract, up to 4 attempts per workload; invalid data are retained and never used or reinterpreted.
